summary: This dbt transformation plan covers the cleaning, staging, and enrichment of five SQLite tables: customer, member, order, product, and transaction. The plan includes staging models for data cleaning, mart models for pass-through, and enriched marts that join related tables based on declared foreign keys. Data quality tests are specified for primary and foreign keys. All logic is conservative and does not invent columns or tables.

derived_models.name: mart_member_enriched
derived_models.logic: Left join stg_member to stg_customer on customer_id to provide customer details for each member.

derived_models.name: mart_order_enriched
derived_models.logic: Left join stg_order to stg_customer on customer_id and to stg_product on product_id to provide customer and product details for each order.

derived_models.name: mart_transaction_enriched
derived_models.logic: Left join stg_transaction to stg_member on member_id, and then to stg_customer on member.customer_id, to provide member and customer details for each transaction.

assumptions: No additional columns or tables are created beyond those in the schema.
Cleaning is limited to type casting and trimming whitespace; no advanced validation is performed.
All joins in enriched marts are left joins to preserve child table records even if parent data is missing.
Date fields are left as TEXT; no date parsing or conversion is performed.
No business logic or derived metrics are added beyond the described joins.
Tests are only applied to primary and foreign key columns as specified.
